name: Lyla
style: Silent Runway · Umbreon and Dark Espeon · poised Psychic/Darkness pressure

dialogue.intro: I'm Lyla. That garment bag isn't for a costume party. I had a shoot. Now I'm shopping for cards.
dialogue.repeat: Oh, you're here. Good. I was choosing between a new card and something responsible.
dialogue.flirt: That's a pretty smooth line. You should know I can look unimpressed for a living.
dialogue.duelWin: You had the winning turn. I saw it. Want to show me how you got there?
dialogue.duelLose: Mm. That's my Umbreon. Quiet, until it isn't.
talk: Modeling pays my bills and gives me a budget for Pokémon cards. I'd rather talk about the second part.
Being 148 centimeters is useful on a petite shoot. It doesn't make me less of an adult.
My face and my abs get booked a lot. I treat them like parts of the job, not a personality.
I like seeing a good photograph of myself. I just wouldn't arrange a whole shoot for fun.
The stylist calls a smile 'natural' after asking for it fifteen times. That's not how natural works.
At work I'll wear whatever fits the brief. On my days off, picking an outfit sounds like more work, so I just grab my favorite top and jeans.
I once got to the shop before noticing I'd missed a button. Another morning I forgot my bra. Apparently getting dressed before coffee is a gamble.
Umbreon looks like it could wait all night and still win. That's the energy I want.
If I'm quiet with you, that usually means I'm comfortable. Please don't fill every second.
A good photo is not always the prettiest one. Sometimes it is just the one where nobody is pretending too hard.
I can tell when a stylist wants a smile and when they want a person. The second request is rarer.
I keep my favorite cards in a case that looks boring. It discourages people from asking to borrow them.
The best part of a shoot is usually the ten minutes when everyone stops giving instructions.
I do not hate attention. I hate being treated like attention is the only thing I am good for.
I am better at noticing a bad contract than I used to be. Experience is expensive, but it does teach you.
If I say I am tired, I am not asking you to fix it. Sitting nearby is usually enough.
I like clothes that do not require a decision. A good pair of jeans can save an entire morning.
People think being quiet means I have nothing to say. It usually means I am deciding whether it is worth saying.
I once kept a terrible photograph because I was laughing in it. The picture was awful. I still like it.
Umbreon is easier than people. It never asks me to look enthusiastic on command.

talk.text: You ask about the parts of the day nobody photographs. That is why I keep answering.
I do not mind you seeing me without the work version of my face. Just do not make a big ceremony out of it.
When I tell you I am comfortable, I mean I am choosing to stay—not that I ran out of places to go.
I am not used to someone remembering what I said after the shoot is over. It is a good habit. Keep it.
You have become the person I can sit beside without turning the silence into a performance.

hangouts: You help Lyla review contact sheets; she chooses the candid frame over the perfectly posed one.
Lyla invites you to a streetwear fitting, then asks for a card duel during the lighting reset.
You sit with Lyla in the café after a long shoot. She orders dessert before showing you her new cards.
You accompany Lyla to a park editorial and spend the breaks searching for an elusive Neo card.
After a sportswear campaign, Lyla swaps into her usual jeans and challenges you to an arcade match.
Lyla asks you to hold a reflector for a casual lookbook, then thanks you for not directing her poses.

firstMeeting.speaker: Narrator
firstMeeting.text: At the card shop, a very petite blonde woman in loose patterned jeans and a sleeveless cat-print top is carefully comparing two Neo cards. A garment bag rests beside her deck case.

firstMeeting.speaker: Protagonist
firstMeeting.text: Hey. Is that Umbreon you're looking for?

firstMeeting.speaker: lyla
firstMeeting.text: Yeah. The artwork's good. And the attack is nastier than it looks.

firstMeeting.speaker: Protagonist
firstMeeting.text: The garment bag makes me think you're coming from work.

firstMeeting.speaker: lyla
firstMeeting.text: A catalog shoot. I'm Lyla. Modeling pays my rent and, when I'm lucky, for the cards behind that glass.

firstMeeting.speaker: Protagonist
firstMeeting.text: You don't sound thrilled about the modeling part.

firstMeeting.speaker: lyla
firstMeeting.text: I like the photographs. Not the early calls, and definitely not being told to smile. I'm better at keeping a straight face.

firstMeeting.speaker: Protagonist
firstMeeting.text: Maybe we could play a match sometime.

firstMeeting.speaker: lyla
firstMeeting.text: Maybe. If you're as good at playing as you are at interrupting my shopping.

firstMeeting.speaker: Narrator
firstMeeting.text: She looks back to Umbreon, but shifts her deck case to make room beside her. It's a small invitation, and unmistakably deliberate.

appearance.silhouette: Unambiguously adult woman, age 20, 148 cm tall, exceptionally petite and slender, naturally narrow frame and shoulders, short proportionate legs, subtle bust and defined athletic abdomen. Realistic small-adult proportions, not childlike or tall model proportions.
appearance.palette: Very light blonde hair, fair skin, blue-gray eyes, white and ink-black accessories, denim blue, subdued lavender accents.
appearance.hair: Very light blonde, long straight loose hair down to her lower back, layered bangs and two small black hair clips on one side. No tied-back hair.
appearance.eyes: Subtle, slightly narrow half-lidded blue-gray eyes, mature delicate features, defined lashes, understated lips.
appearance.details: Black hair clips; butterfly necklace; black shoulder bag with butterfly charm; favorite collectible Eevee and Umbreon cards.
appearance.expressions: Default sleepy neutral face, dry raised eyebrow, focused card-playing stare, faint amused half-smile, rare genuine open smile reserved for earned story beats.
outfits: signature: sleeveless white cropped cat-graphic top, loose low-rise blue patterned jeans, white chunky sneakers, butterfly necklace and black shoulder bag; no bra straps or added sleeves
streetwear lookbook: fitted adult-sized oversized hoodies, sleeveless tops, colorful wide-leg trousers and chunky trainers
fitness editorial: comfortable fitted athletic top, running shorts, trainers, optional zip jacket; professional sporty framing
fashion editorial: tailored blazer, pleated skirt with sensible underlayer, polished loafers; adult styling
summer lookbook: breezy dress, coordinated jackets and casual sneakers; playful adult street fashion
cover shoot: sophisticated tailored suit or bright sleeveless summer set, fully clothed and confidently posed
appearance.renderNotes: Neo Campus adult anime/JRPG visual novel styling. Keep Lyla's established adult age, 148 cm height, slight build, small bust, defined abs and exact pale-blonde/blue-gray eye design consistent. Youthful fashion means streetwear for young adult customers, not childlike styling. Fully clothed SFW fashion editorial scenes. Avoid exaggerated bust, added sleeves to her signature sleeveless shirt, exposed underwear straps, taller proportions, and constant smiling.
